// baseReturnChancePercent: Baseline chance an insured item is RETURNED, by what killed you. Competence and the extraction roll move it from here.
// looterCompetence: How good was this particular looter? Rolled ONCE per raid on 0-100. Level only sets the MEAN - sigma decides how much level actually predicts, so a high-level killer is often no better than a low-level one.
// valueWeightedLooting: Decide how MANY items were taken once per raid, then pick WHICH ones weighted by price. This is what stops every raid returning the same middling fraction.
// looterExtractedChancePercent: Baseline chance the killer survived and extracted with your gear, before competence is applied.
// looterDiedBonusPercent: Added to the return chance when the killer did NOT extract.
// legacyPackageBehaviour: Packages insured before this mod was installed: 'spt' = use SPT's flat chance, 'other' = treat as the 'other' bucket.
